headline: With Dazzle, Marissa Mayer bets your camera roll has more info on your life than your inbox
context: Mayer argues that if a photo is worth a thousand words, your camera roll is worth millions. By analyzing all the photos stored on your phone, Dazzle claims to understand your hobbies, interests, food, and style preferences, how you like to spend their time, and with whom.

sources.name: TechCrunch
